articles.title: Bitcoin-backed lending is entering its institutional era: Two Prime
articles.snippet: Public companies are increasingly borrowing against their bitcoin holdings to fund acquisitions and capital spending without selling the asset.

articles.title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
articles.snippet: The license allows ARP Digital to offer regulated digital asset and stablecoin conversions into UAE dirhams as it expands its Gulf presence beyond Bahrain.

articles.title: Coinbase-backed Flowdesk secures full broker-dealer license in Dubai
articles.snippet: Flowdesk’s VARA approval follows its MiCA authorization in France as crypto firms build regulated operations across major global markets.

articles.title: Thailand’s 0% crypto tax. Bitcoin Red Team forced to use Chinese AI: Asia Express
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin Red Team has been forced to rely on open source Chinese AI, after OpenAI restricted access. Thailand sets crypto tax to 0% in bid to become crypto hub.

articles.title: Wall Street Is Starting to Treat Data Center Backlash as a Credit Risk
articles.snippet: Banks financing the AI infrastructure boom are now weighing local public opposition alongside permits and costs.
